newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Nepal protests Bangladeshi leader's remark.
newsitem.headline: Nepal protests Bangladeshi leader's remark.

text.p: Nepal has protested against remarks by Bangladeshi opposition leader and former Prime Minister Begum Khaleda Zia questioning the sovereignty of the Himalayan kingdom, a Dhaka daily said on Tuesday.
"The government of Nepal is deeply hurt at the remarks by Begum Khaleda Zia," The Independent newpaper quoted an unnamed Nepali diplomat as saying.

Khaleda, criticising recent moves by India and Bangladesh to forge a sub-regional trade bloc, said the grouping would undermine the sovereignty of Bangladesh and New Delhi "will treat us (Bangladesh) like Nepal and Bhutan".
"The remarks cast serious aspersions on the status of Nepal," the diplomat said.
The proposed sub-regional trade bloc groups Nepal and Bhutan besides India and Bangladesh.
Nepal's ambassador to Bangladesh, Lok Bahadur Shrestha, had sent a letter to Begum Zia protesting her remarks, the Independent said.
Leaders of Khaleda's Bangladesh Nationalist Party could not be reached for comment or to confirm whether their leader had received the letter of protest from the Nepali embassy.
